Title: Azure Backup availability with Resource Manager in Azure Government

Body.Content:
Azure Government has revamped Azure Backup capabilities for Azure Government customers. These capabilities include:

  • Recovery Services vault that supports both Azure Backup and Azure Site Recovery
  • Azure Resource Manager VM backup
  • Backup of VMs running on Azure Premium Storage
  • Backup of encrypted VMs
  • Integration of Backup into the VM blade
  • Monitoring of on-premises backups through the Azure portal
  • Enhanced security features of Azure Backup for protecting cloud backups against ransomware attacks
  • VMware backup with Azure Backup server

For more information, visit the Azure blog.
